reviews.text: いいです！すぐ馴染ませないと、、みたいな声を聞きましたがそこまで焦らなくてもぼかせました。このリップペンシルに合わせてもうちょっとオレンジのリップ買ってみようと思います。強いて言うならあと少しだけ細いと助かります！
reviews.zh: 好用！聽過有人話要快啲 blend，但我覺得唔使咁趕都可以 blend 得開。我想配搭呢支唇筆去買一支再橙少少嘅唇膏試下。要挑剔嘅話，再幼少少會更加好！

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Pink Mousse (+Melting Gloss Mini Pink Hour)
reviews.text: Very nice even though the color is not match with me. A little bright for Asian skin. Really long lasting
reviews.zh: 雖然顏色唔啱我，但都幾好。對亞洲膚色嚟講有少少太鮮。持久度真係好好。

reviews.shade: [SET] 02 Pink Mousse (+Melting Gloss Mini Pink Hour)
reviews.text: The color is different as I expected. The texture is smooth and easy to blend. The complementary lip gloss is beyond the expectation and the lip brush is pretty good!
reviews.zh: 顏色同我預期嘅唔同。質地順滑易推開。跟機送嘅唇彩超乎預期，唇掃都幾好！

reviews.shade: [SET] 06 Mute Peach (+Melting Gloss Mini Nudy Cocoa)
reviews.text:
塗って少し待つと擦ってもびくともしません。その分少しキシキシと感じるテクスチャーですがティントやグロスなどを重ねるため問題ありません。擦っても全くよれることがないので、太めのアイライナーペンシルといった感じです。
色味は商品画像より少量ローズが加わった色です。
reviews.zh: 塗上去等一陣之後，就算摩擦都紋風不動。質地因為咁所以摸落有少少乾爭爭嘅感覺，但因為之後會疊 tint 或者 gloss，所以冇問題。就算摩擦都完全唔會化開，感覺好似粗身啲嘅 eyeliner pencil。色調比起商品圖片加咗少少玫瑰色。

reviews.text: Don’t get the hype, really odd texture and interferes with my lipstick colour in pretty much any formulation - gloss, tint, matte or satin.
reviews.zh: 真係睇唔明點解咁紅，質地好奇怪，而且幾乎同任何配方嘅唇膏撞色——gloss、tint、matte 或者 satin 都中晒。

reviews.shade: [SET] 05 Neutral Gray (Lip Pointing Tint Mini Moody Grape)
reviews.text: Wow! This product was unexpected. It’s a really nice contour shade for the lips. I have fair skin and prefer neutral/cool shading shades. This is perfect for that! It’s not orange and you can blend it for a lighter look. It’s such a pretty product I’m so glad to have it! The swatch next to it is the extra gift. That also has a nice formula and colour but be sure not to accidentally taste it. Lol, wasn’t pleasant! I 100% recommend this lip liner! (The swatch I took does have a filter that changes the colour slightly.)
reviews.zh: 哇！呢件產品完全出乎意料。佢係一個好好嘅唇部 contour 色號。我膚色偏白，鍾意 neutral 或者 cool 嘅 shading 色號。呢個就啱晒！佢唔會偏橙，而且可以推開做到更淡嘅效果。件產品真係好靚，好開心入手咗！隔離嗰個試色係送嘅贈品。嗰個嘅配方同顏色都唔錯，但千祈唔好唔小心試味。哈哈，真係唔係幾好味！我 100% 推薦呢枝唇線筆！（我影嘅試色有加 filter，所以顏色會有少少唔同。）

reviews.shade: [SET] 05 Neutral Gray (Lip Pointing Tint Mini Moody Grape)
reviews.text: first off, this liner does adhere to the lip very well. too well to where it makes it hard to smudge or blend if you want to blur your lip line. the shade neutral gray looked okay in the packaging and swatched on my hand, but it’s way too white and chalky once i put it anywhere near my lips. it’s giving powdered donut. 😭 i wish this particular shade was less white based or just darker. it’s hard for me to find a way to wear this (typically a shade 23 in complexion products).
reviews.zh: 首先，呢枝 liner 真係好貼唇。貼到一個點係，如果你想 blur 唇線嘅話，會好難推開或者 blend。neutral gray 呢個色號喺包裝上面睇落 ok，試喺手上都 ok，但一搽近嘴唇就會即刻太白太粉，有種 powdered donut 嘅感覺。😭 我希望呢個色號冇咁 white based，或者深色少少。我（平時用 complexion product 係 23 色）真係諗唔到點樣 carry 呢枝。

reviews.shade: [SET] 03 Rose Cotton (+Lip Pointing Tint Mini Fig Latte)
reviews.text: product adheres well to lips, which helps with longevity, but makes it harder to smudge and blend. the shade rose cotton is pretty white based and will look chalky if you’re not pale. it’s wearable if you work with it, by blending it out and pairing it with other lip products.
reviews.zh: 產品貼唇效果好，所以有助持久，但同時會比較難推開同 blend。rose cotton 呢個色號幾 white based，如果你唔係白底嘅話會顯得粉粉哋。如果你肯花心機 blend 開再配搭其他唇妝產品，都仲 carry 得到。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
